verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents a public API and says you can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow,' which loosely implies broad coverage. Nothing in the evidence lists endpoints or shows that UI actions such as scan requests, forwarding, check deposit, shredding, tagging or automation rules are exposed via the API. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs. That is a gap in evidence, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: endpoint-level API documentation, evidence of UI-to-API parity for core mail actions (scan, forward, deposit, shred, tag, rules), a published API spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
